forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {立|た}てかけていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to lean (something against), to rest (something against)
definitions.explanation: To place something in a leaning position against another object.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梯子|はしご}→梯子：00092_hashigo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}てかけた。
examples.english: I leaned the ladder against the wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}てかける。
examples.english: To lean an umbrella in the entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}てかけておいた。
examples.english: I left the bicycle leaning against a tree.

notes:
{立|た}てかける means to place something in a leaning position against a surface. It is a compound verb from ⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to stand up) + かける (to hang/rest on).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- The person actively places the object

COMMON PATTERNS:
[object]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧[surface]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}てかける
- ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}てかける: to lean an umbrella against the wall
- ⟦{梯子|はしご}→梯子：00092_hashigo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}てかける: to lean a ladder against a tree

ASPECT (ている):
{立|た}てかけて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ / {立|た}てかけて⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ both describe the resulting state: something is leaning against a surface.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to stand something up (upright, not leaning)
- {寄|よ}りかかる: to lean oneself against (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧, intransitive)
- {立|た}てかける implies the object leans at an angle, not standing straight
